checks.sub: Six points we put in writing on every Barcelona contract.

items.title: The rent cap
items.text: A tensioned zone: new rents are capped by the reference index and the previous rent. Above it is leverage. We run the check.

items.title: Who may charge you
items.text: Intermediation in Catalonia needs AICAT registration; the landlord pays their own agent. We open with a registered partner and never take landlord money.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: One month by law. Extra guarantees are capped at two months' rent. Agents still ask for more. We don't let them.

items.title: Contract type
items.text: Many Barcelona listings are 'temporada' leases, which do not protect you like a habitual-residence lease. We check which one you are handed.

items.title: Registration
items.text: Registered at the town hall with your contract: health card and school place hang on it. We confirm it before you pay.

items.title: Income rules
items.text: Payslips, a bank guarantee, a Spanish guarantor: each landlord asks differently. New job, foreign salary, freelance — we write it so it passes.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Barcelona, the tenant-side desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency, opening with a registered local partner (AICAT). Hired and paid by the tenant only.
Internationals relocating to Barcelona — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
VAT included, charged only when the desk opens. No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.
Today: your file, opened and kept ready. When the desk opens: Spanish-format file in 24 hours, applications within the hour, attended viewings, rent cap and contract checked, padrón supported.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date, and we don't intermediate in Catalonia before the desk opens.

items.q: Why isn't BOOM taking searches in Barcelona yet?
items.a: In Catalonia, intermediation needs registration in the AICAT register. We open the desk with a registered local partner rather than work around the rule. Your file waits, ready, and you hear from us the day the desk opens.

items.q: What can you do for me today?
items.a: Open your file, answer your questions the same working day, and tell you honestly what your budget buys in Barcelona. The prices on this page are set; nothing is charged until the desk opens and the work starts.

items.q: Is my rent capped in Barcelona?
items.a: Barcelona is a tensioned residential zone: new rents are capped by the índice de referencia and the previous rent. An asking rent above the cap is leverage, not a given. That check is part of every Barcelona search.

items.q: Do I need to be in Barcelona?
items.a: No. When the desk opens, a BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is read and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the padrón.

items.q: Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain?
items.a: The landlord bears their own agency costs. An agent you hire, who works only for you, is a different service. That is what we are, and we never take anything from landlords or their agents.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: It is used to answer you and to open your file, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.

footer.tagline: Born in Rome, built for people who move countries. The same rules in Barcelona: one side of the table, everything in writing — and a registered partner before the first search.
